items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: I loved it down there because I was, my uncle, who I was very attached to, married to my aunt, my father's sister.

ctx.x: Did you live around Decatur and, uh, Frenchman ever?

No. I used to stay down there with them. I loved it down there because I was, my uncle, who I was very attached to, married to my aunt, my father's sister. And, uh, I loved it down there. I enjoyed it. My uncle was a, was a cabinet maker. And, uh, that's where I think I got my knowledge of cabinet making. And he was quite a guy. And, uh, I liked him very much. In fact, I used to, I lived up on Napoleon Avenue and Franklin, which is Napoleon Avenue, and Liberty now. Mm-hmm. Right. Not Liberty. I mean, uh,…
Did any of your, uh, uncles play music?
